reading.title: Fruits 1: Choosing Fruit at the Market
reading.text: At a produce market, a shopper chooses fruit for breakfast, snacks, and a weekend meal. The first stall has apple, banana, orange, grape, and strawberry. Another display offers watermelon, pineapple, mango, peach, and pear. For a mixed fruit dish, the shopper considers blueberry, raspberry, blackberry, cranberry, and gooseberry. The shopper checks ripeness and buys only what will be used.
